name: Anderson County, KS
findings: Anderson County has 30 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (80% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Anderson County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
55% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Anderson County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 60% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 60% of all organizations here have no identified type.
